command: set -euo pipefail; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; echo APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'); if command -v apkanalyzer >/dev/null 2>&1; then test "$(apkanalyzer manifest application-id "$APK")" = 'io.blueeye'; elif command -v aapt >/dev/null 2>&1; then aapt dump badging "$APK" | head -n 1 | grep -q "package: name='io.blueeye'"; fi
